# balance studios

> Reformer Pilates studios in Ireland, with six locations: Limerick, Clane, Kildare, Blessington, Enfield and Bray. For those who expect more.

balance runs small-group Reformer Pilates classes. Mat and Barre run at Limerick and Kildare, and Yoga at Limerick and Kildare. New clients can try 3 Reformer classes for €50.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, intro offer and studios.
- [Our studios](/our-studios): All six studios with addresses, parking and classes.
- [Class types](/classes): Classic, Sculpt, Challenge, Gentle Flow, Mat, Barre and Yoga.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Class packs and monthly memberships.
- [Schedule](/schedule): Live timetable for all studios.
- [About](/about): The story of balance and founder Kelly.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about classes and booking.
